mapper.select: SELECT r.id AS room_id, r.room_no, r.room_name, COUNT(bo.id) AS occupied_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.gender = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS male_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.gender = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS female_count FROM hostel_room r LEFT JOIN booking_order bo ON bo.room_id = r.id AND bo.deleted = 0 AND bo.order_status IN (2, 3, 4) AND bo.check_in_date < #{checkOutDate} AND #{checkInDate} < bo.check_out_date LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = bo.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.id = #{roomId} GROUP BY r.id, r.room_no, r.room_name
